label: Every finite selection of the complete infinite-tail Grim Reaper clauses is satisfiable by an…
meaning: Distinguish compatibility of every finite selection of complete unbounded-tail action clauses from one assignment satisfying their whole infinite family. This strengthens the old three-Reaper truncation control while importing the old infinite impossibility proof. It supplies no ordinary finitary compactness counterexample, countable metaphysical assembly principle, causal finitism, grounding foundation or philosophical premise discharge.
